 PFL Dubai highlight video: Connor Hughes knocks out Shaqueme Rock
 Mike Sloan Nov 14, 2026 
 Connor Hughes ended his grudge match with Shaqueme Rock with a spectacular knockout in the second. Hughes landed a perfect left hook, right cross combo to the head during an exchange and the punches knocked Rock out cold.
